review_candidates.description: Description synthétique du poste Sous l'autorité du conseiller de coopération et d'action culturelle, directeur de l’Institut Français, vous devrez piloter, organiser et gérer l’Institut Français- Antenne de Bandung en Indonésie. Activités principales L’IFI Bandung est implanté dans ses locaux historiques depuis sa création en 1975. Les locaux appartiennent à l’association franco-indonésienne locale PPKIP. L’IFI a fait l’objet de rénovations régulières depuis 2019 (auditorium, toiture, installation électrique…) et fait l’objet de la mise en place d’un plan pluriannuel d’entretien. Présent à Bandung depuis 50 ans, l’IFI est une institution reconnue et bénéficie d’un bon réseau de partenaires culturels et universitaires. Mais l’IFI Bandung doit faire face à une concurrence accrue de structures et de particuliers dans les domaines culturels et linguistiques d’où la nécessité d’innover et de communiquer opportunément sur les actions menées. Dans ce cadre vous devrez : - Élaborer, proposer et impulser la stratégie de l'établissement, en lien avec le COCAC (Conseiller de coopération et d'action culturelle) et dans le respect des priorités d'action du poste dans les domaines culturels, de coopération ou du développement ; - Participer à l'élaboration du budget, à la gestion du personnel et à la mise en place d'outils d'analyse, de suivi et d'évaluation en liaison avec l'Ambassade de France ; - Mettre en œuvre les priorités définies par le ministère et l'Ambassade ; - Animer des équipes ; - Mettre en place des partenariats ; - Organiser des événements et des manifestations ; - Établir d'étroites relations avec les réseaux professionnels et les autorités du pays afin de promouvoir l'établissement ; - Gérer les risques et veiller à l'application des consignes de sécurité : - Rechercher des financements et lever des fonds auprès de bailleurs publics et privés ; - Préparer et remettre des rapports réguliers d'activité. Diplômes ou expérience professionnelle recommandée pour exercer les fonctions Niveau Master ou équivalent Expérience préalable dans le réseau culturel français à l’étranger La connaissance ou la maîtrise de l'indonésien constituerait un atout. La connaissance de la région également.

review_candidates.title: Deputy Manager - Boiler Maintenance
review_candidates.description: Purpose / Objective To ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operation and maintenance of Boiler Systems and Boiler Auxiliaries in large utility-scale thermal power plants. The role is responsible for executing preventive, predictive, breakdown, and shutdown maintenance activities to maximize equipment availability, improve reliability, reduce forced outages, and support generation targets while ensuring compliance with safety, quality, and statutory requirements. Description for Internal Candidates About Business Adani Power Limited (APL) , a part of the Adani Group, is India's largest private thermal power producer with a diversified portfolio of utility-scale thermal power plants across multiple locations. Adani Power is committed to operational excellence, reliability improvement, safety leadership, and world-class O&M practices. Key Responsibilities of Role Boiler Maintenance Execute preventive, predictive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance activities of Boiler systems and auxiliaries. Ensure high availability and reliability of Boiler equipment and associated systems. Monitor equipment health and recommend corrective actions to minimize forced outages. Support maintenance planning and execution in line with approved maintenance schedules. Boiler Systems & Auxiliaries Maintain and monitor the health of: Boiler Pressure Parts Water Wall Tubes Superheater Reheater Economiser Boiler Headers APH (Air Preheater) ESP (Electrostatic Precipitator) PA Fans FD Fans ID Fans Soot Blowers Coal Piping Expansion Joints Dampers Valves and Supports PF (Pulverized Fuel) Firing System and associated auxiliaries Shutdown & Overhaul Management Participate in Annual Overhaul (AOH), Capital Overhaul (COH), and planned shutdown activities. Execute major maintenance activities within approved timelines and quality standards. Coordinate with Operations, Electrical, C&I, CHP, AHP, and contractor teams during shutdowns. Support commissioning and post-maintenance trial runs of equipment. Reliability Improvement Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) of recurring failures. Support implementation of Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) and predictive maintenance initiatives. Participate in condition monitoring activities including vibration monitoring, thermography, thickness measurement, and equipment inspections. Identify opportunities for reliability enhancement, equipment life improvement, and forced outage reduction. Documentation & Maintenance Planning Maintain detailed equipment history and maintenance records. Prepare maintenance reports, technical audit reports, RCA reports, AOH/COH reports, and maintenance MIS. Draft and update Standard Maintenance Procedures (SMPs). Ensure accurate documentation in SAP PM and maintenance management systems. Inventory & Cost Management Monitor critical spare parts inventory and material availability. Raise purchase requisitions and support procurement activities for maintenance requirements. Ensure optimum utilization of maintenance resources and budget. Assist in annual maintenance planning and budgeting activities. Safety, Quality & Compliance Ensure strict compliance with PTW, LOTO, EHS standards, and Adani Safety Protocols. Conduct maintenance activities in accordance with safety procedures and statutory requirements. Support contractor safety management and safety training initiatives. Participate in safety audits, risk assessments, and quality compliance reviews. Stakeholder Coordination Coordinate with Operations, CHP, Ash Handling, Electrical, C&I, Engineering, Stores, and Contractor teams. Support timely completion of maintenance activities through effective cross-functional coordination. Assist section heads and maintenance leads in emergency handling and restoration activities. Qualifications and Experience Educational Qualification Mandatory B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized University / Institute. Experience 6–12 Years of relevant experience in Boiler Maintenance. Mandatory Experience Must have hands-on experience in maintenance of Pulverized Fuel (PF) Boilers . Must have worked in thermal power plants with unit capacity of 500 MW and above . Experience in utility-scale thermal power plants is mandatory. Exposure to Supercritical and Subcritical Boiler Units will be preferred. Experience in maintenance of Boiler Pressure Parts, APH, ESP, PA Fans, FD Fans, ID Fans, Soot Blowers, Coal Piping, and associated auxiliaries. Experience in Annual Overhauls (AOH), Capital Overhauls (COH), and major shutdown maintenance activities. Working knowledge of SAP PM or equivalent maintenance management systems. Essential Areas of Expertise Boiler Maintenance Pulverized Fuel (PF) Boilers Boiler Pressure Parts APH Maintenance ESP Maintenance PA/FD/ID Fan Maintenance Soot Blower Systems Coal Piping Systems Shutdown & Overhaul Management Reliability Engineering Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Predictive & Preventive Maintenance SAP PM Condition Monitoring Thermal Power Plant O&M Preferred Candidate Profile Experience in thermal power plants having 500 MW, 600 MW, 660 MW, 800 MW or higher capacity units . Strong understanding of PF Boiler maintenance, outage management, reliability improvement, and equipment troubleshooting. Good communication, team coordination, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work in a high-performance, safety-focused thermal power generation environment.
